# Kennery: Home Inventory

> Kennery is a home inventory app for people who will never keep up a real one. Instead of
> cataloging everything you own, you write one short line about where something went —
> "winter boots, under the bed, blue bin" — with an optional photo, and search for it months
> later. Local-only: no accounts, no cloud sync, no analytics. Everything stays on the device.

## Who it's for
Homeowners, renters, and people moving house who lose track of things they've stored away —
seasonal decorations, spare parts, documents, the box of cables in the garage — and want to
find them again without building and maintaining a full inventory database.

## How it differs from other home inventory apps
Most home inventory apps are built around cataloging: categories, valuations, barcode
scanning, receipts, and a subscription to keep access to your own list. Kennery does one
thing — records where an item is and lets you search for it — and charges once.

## What it does not do
Kennery is not insurance-documentation software. It has no valuation, receipt, serial-number
or policy fields and produces no insurer-ready report. It records location, not worth.

## Pricing
- Free tier: track up to 20 items
- Kennery Pro: $4.99 one-time purchase, no subscription, unlimited items

## Privacy
No account, no cloud, no analytics, no advertising identifiers. Items and photos are stored
in on-device storage only. Users can export a personal backup file and re-import it.

Thomas Hornig
